item.title: "Llegó el día de devolver la camiseta número siete": Cristiano Ronaldo se retira de Portugal
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo anunció este 5 de noviembre su retirada definitiva de la selección de Portugal, con la que disputó 234 partidos y marcó 146 goles. A los 41 años, el delantero puso fin a una trayectoria de 23 años en la que conquistó la Eurocopa de 2016 y dos ediciones de la Liga de Naciones, aunque no logró ganar el Mundial. "Llegó el día de devolver la camiseta número siete a la selección de todos nosotros", anunció en un vídeo publicado en Instagram, en el que repasó su carrera y agradeció a los aficionados, compañeros, entrenadores y responsables del fútbol portugués. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Why Iraola's Liverpool are still a work in progress
item.description: Champions League analyst Stephen Warnock and Guillem Balague believe Liverpool's defensive weaknesses combined with the experimentation of playing Bradley Barcola up front, highlight Andoni Iraola's team are still trying to find their identity following a 3-2 defeat to Fenerbahce in the Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.description: A world record of 43 players, eight members of staff and two board members were sent off during an under-20 championship match between Uberlandia and Mamore in Brazil. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Como score nine to make Champions League history
item.description: Anastasios Douvikas scores a hat-trick as Como produce a stunning 9-1 away win over Lens on match day four, recording the biggest away win in Champions League history. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: No end in sight for Russell as he eyes famous All Blacks win
item.description: Finn Russell is frustrated at questions about when he might retire as the Scotland fly-half sounds refreshed as he prepares for another attempt to end their hoodoo against the All Blacks. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Another 'miracle' in Istanbul - but this one hurt Liverpool
item.description: Liverpool conceded "cheap" and "messy" goals in their defeat by Fenerbahce, says boss Andoni Iraola, as former Reds hero Dirk Kuyt celebrates a "miracle" in Istanbul. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: LIV to wind down after backers withdraw support
item.description: LIV Golf is set to announce on Thursday it will wind down after a financing firm retracted its support. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Champions League: Real Madrid seal late comeback as Liverpool lose to Fenerbahce
item.description: Real Madrid maintained their perfect Champions League record as Federico Valverde’s stoppage-time strike secured a 3-2 comeback win at AEK Athens on Wednesday. Madrid twice trailed before Valverde scored from long range in the 92nd minute. Liverpool’s winning start ended with a surprise 3-2 defeat at Fenerbahce in the competition. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Emphatic Porto thrash Napoli in second-half romp
item.description: Porto score three goals in the final 20 minutes of the game to pull away and seal a comfortable victory against Napoli, who are unable to match their Portuguese opponents in the second half. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Haaland scores winner as Man City beat Leipzig
item.description: Erling Haaland scores the winning goal as Manchester City overcome being pegged back twice to beat RB Leipzig 3-2 on match day four of the UEFA Champions League group phase. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: LIV Golf future in doubt as premier says Australia event likely cancelled
item.description: The future of LIV Golf appears to be in serious doubt after reports that BC Partners, which provides financing to middle-market companies, is dropping its bid to relaunch the league. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Arsenal survive late Slavia scare for hard-fought win
item.description: Arsenal earn their third win from four in the Champions League as goals from Noni Madueke and Victor Gyokeres are too much for Slavia Prague, despite a valiant late fight from the hosts to get back into the game. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Liverpool crumble at Kuyt's Fenerbahce
item.description: Liverpool are defeated by Turkish side Fenerbahce, who twice fought back from behind to seal a famous victory, ending the Reds' perfect start to this year's Champions League after four games. Fuente: BBC Sport.
